text: ¡Hola! This is Espanish. Your Spanish, your way — with your own profesora.
Step one: a quick level check. A few questions, a little Spanish. Not sure? Tap “I don't know”. ¡Tranquilo!
Then sign up with the same email. Your level comes with you. ¡Perfecto!
Add it to your phone: Safari, Share, “Add to Home Screen”. ¡Listo!
Open it and turn on notifications, so you never miss a message — or a clase.
Every day, the big card tells you what's next.
Chat with your profesora: photos, links, and translation in one tap.
Do your homework right in the app. Got it right? ¡Muy bien!
Every class and every new word is saved, with audio. Practice palabra por palabra.
Your calendar, and your own folder, with materials made just for you.
And your teacher plans every class around you.
